description: A block of short lines in a smaller font surrounded by a vector frame (fill) — tests the edge of a vector region as a block boundary.

expected.note: Construction fact: 4 'before' lines (size 10, y=700..640), 4 block lines (size 8, y=600..555) INSIDE a filled rectangle (x=65-315,y=548-610), 4 'after' lines (size 10, y=500..440) OUTSIDE the rectangle. A vector region 'fill' with that bbox must appear in InventoryResult.vectors. buildSemanticBlocks() must separate the block inside the frame as a SEPARATE block (a boundary at the edge of the vector region), regardless of whether the font/line-spacing change alone would do it. totalItemCount=14 (not 12): pdf.js inserts an empty synthetic TextItem at every mid-stream font size change (Tf between Tj) — here 2 transitions (10->8 before the block, 8->10 after), hence 12 lines + 2 empty = 14.
